它在所有NEMAR下载边界捕获泄漏的httpx.TransportError异常。
该版本保留默认auto provider回退到各数据集自身下载器。
bullets_en: MOABB v1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable.
It catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries.
The release preserves the default auto provider fallback to each dataset's own downloader.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.1修复NEMAR网络错误，提升离线缓存可用性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.1 fixes NEMAR network errors and improves offline cached dataset usability.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

bullets_zh: MOABB v1.7.0修复NEMAR预取前的离线缓存数据访问。

bullets_en: MOABB v1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access before NEMAR prefetch.
It makes dataset bubble plots reproducible with stable layout behavior.
The release improves reliability of benchmark workflows when networks are unavailable.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.0改善离线缓存与可复现气泡图，增强BCI评测稳定性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.0 improves offline caching and reproducible bubble plots for stable BCI benchmarking.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible. - `BaseDataset.get_data` now uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, so cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable. - `dataset_bubble_plot` now has reproducible layouts by default and accepts `random_state` for controlled alternatives. Full changelog: https://moabb.
